synthesis:draft.headline: AEMO’s operational demand includes electricity consumed by scheduled loads (and scheduled bidirectional units).

document_statements.paraphrase: AEMO’s operational demand composition includes local demand of scheduled loads and scheduled bidirectional units (scheduled BDUs) [c1].
Measured operational demand is recorded in the EMMS data model as the field OPERATIONAL_DEMAND [c2].
